paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: (left) and (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve .
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the CoLeG-R percentage for different LLaMA-2 models under various SFT conditions. The horizontal axis lists three categories: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, representing different model scales. The vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", ranging from 0 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of four bars, colored blue, yellow, purple, and pink, corresponding to "no SFT", "+ SFT on D0", "+ SFT on D0, D1", and "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" respectively, as indicated by the legend. The bars for each group are positioned side by side, with the blue bar representing the baseline "no SFT" condition, and the subsequent bars showing the effect of adding SFT on different datasets. The CoLeG-R percentages for the "no SFT" condition are approximately 68, 70, and 81 for LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, respectively, while the values for the "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2" condition are around 84, 80, and 83. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
